Implement activateX() function calling _activateAddress() or _activateUint() Pattern: - queueX() stores pending value and ETA (now + 7 days) - activateX() checks ETA has passed, then applies the change - This enforces 7-day delay on top of Timelock's 48h delay Example: ```solidity PendingAddress private _pendingFeeRecipient; function queueFeeRecipient(address newAddr) external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {     _queueAddress(_pendingFeeRecipient, newAddr);     emit FeeRecipientQueued(feeRecipient, newAddr, _pendingFeeRecipient.eta); } function activateFeeRecipient() external onlyRole(ROLE_TIMELOCK) {     address old = feeRecipient;     feeRecipient = _activateAddress(_pendingFeeRecipient);     emit FeeRecipientActivated(old, feeRecipient); } ```","kind":"dev","methods":{},"title":"SlowLaneQueueActivateUpgradeable","version":1},"userdoc":{"errors":{"InvalidValue()":[{"notice":"Error thrown when value is invalid (e.g., zero address)"}],"NoPending()":[{"notice":"Error thrown when no pending change exists"}],"NotReady(uint64)":[{"notice":"Error thrown when trying to activate before ETA"}]},"kind":"user","methods":{"SLOW_DELAY()":{"notice":"Slow lane delay: 7 days"}},"notice":"Upgradeable version of SlowLaneQueueActivate","version":1}},"settings":{"compilationTarget":{"contracts/shared/governance/SlowLaneQueueActivateUpgradeable.sol":"SlowLaneQueueActivateUpgradeable"},"evmVersion":"prague","libraries":{},"metadata":{"bytecodeHash":"ipfs"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":1},"remappings":[":@openzeppelin/=node_modules/@openzeppelin/",":forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/",":halmos-cheatcodes/=lib/halmos-cheatcodes/"],"viaIR":true},"sources":{"contracts/shared/governance/SlowLaneQueueActivateUpgradeable.sol":{"keccak256":"0x465a9d0d3402a3581324702ac9dc80dc4f2db4985ece9436e16bcf0b57568db6","license":"Apache-2.0","urls":["bzz-raw://9ac771a6e6634b44c8ebca1ce5f5d381d27d69df10cbc5e224cf962ee0eb7c09","dweb:/ipfs/QmRRzTVffBqif9R9pdMkPa2Ac1wmXFb39QDLvWqH8bqho3"]}},"version":1}
